Software Misc

group PPT_SW_MISC

Software miscellaneous definition.

Defines

PPT_REG_OFFSET(entry, offset0, size0, offset1, size1) (((entry) < PPT_ENTRY_NUM_ORI) ? ((size0)*(entry) + (offset0)) : ((size1) * ((entry) - PPT_ENTRY_NUM_ORI) + (offset1)))

Obtain the register offset of the specific entry.

Some registers have specific offsets at different entry to facilitate obtaining the register address offset for the specific entry.

参数:

  • entry -- [in] Channel index.

  • offset0 -- [in] Register offset0.

  • size0 -- [in] Entry step size0.

  • offset1 -- [in] Register offset1.

  • size1 -- [in] Entry step size1.

返回:

Register address offset.

PPT_TX_STACK_ENTRY(tx_stack, tx_len) (tx_stack.tx_entry_1_0 + (tx_len.tx_entry_2 << 2))

Obtain the tx entry in the tx stack information.

The tx entry value is contained in PRO_TX_STACK and PRO_TX_LENGTH two registers.

参数:

  • tx_stack -- [in] Refer to PRO_TX_STACK_TYPE.

  • tx_len -- [in] Refer to PRO_TX_LENGTH_TYPE.

返回:

The tx entry in the tx stack information.

PPT_RX_STACK_ENTRY(rx_stack) (rx_stack.entry_0 + (rx_stack.entry_2_1 << 1))

Obtain the rx entry in the rx stack information.

The rx entry value is contained in two discontinuous fields of PRO_RX_STACK register.

参数:

  • rx_stack -- [in] Refer to PRO_RX_STACK_TYPE.

返回:

The rx entry in the rx stack information.

PPT_RX_FIFO_HEADER_SIZE(hp_size, length_size, hs_size) ((((hp_size) + (length_size) + (hs_size) + 15) >> 4) << 1)

Obtain the header size pushed to the Rx FIFO.

The Rx FIFO is filled with the header and the payload of a packet. The header contains the header prefix, length and header suffix. The total size will be aligned to 16 bits when filling to the Rx FIFO.

参数:

  • hp_size -- [in] Header prefix size in bits.

  • length_size -- [in] Payload length size in bits.

  • hs_size -- [in] Header suffix size in bits.

返回:

Header size in bytes.

PPT_RX_FIFO_HEADER_SIZE_BYTE(hp_size, length_size, hs_size) PPT_RX_FIFO_HEADER_SIZE(hp_size << 3, length_size << 3, hs_size << 3)

Obtain the header size pushed to the Rx FIFO.

The Rx FIFO is filled with the header and the payload of a packet. The header contains the header prefix, length and header suffix. The total size will be aligned to 16 bits when filling to the Rx FIFO.

参数:

  • hp_size -- [in] Header prefix size in bytes.

  • length_size -- [in] Payload length size in bytes.

  • hs_size -- [in] Header suffix size in bytes.

返回:

Header size in bytes.

PPT_ISR_ENABLE() NVIC_EnableIRQ(BTMAC_IRQn)

Enable radio interrupt.

PPT_ISR_DISABLE() NVIC_DisableIRQ(BTMAC_IRQn)

Disable radio interrupt.

ppt_native_time_elapse(time_end, time_start) ((time_end) >= (time_start) ? (time_end) - (time_start) : PPT_NATIVE_TIME_MAX_VALUE - (time_start) + 1 + (time_end))

Calculate elapsed time of two native time timestamps.

Use ppt_native_time_read to attain the native time.

参数:

  • time_end -- [in] Time ending point.

  • time_start -- [in] Time starting point.

返回:

Elapsed time in microsecond.
